verdict.rationale: Google Workspace's own docs confirm a pre-integrated SAML SSO app catalog, with a custom-SAML path for apps not in it, SSO into company cloud apps with managed Google credentials, and automatic user provisioning to third-party apps such as Office 365. Nothing in the evidence shows how large the catalog is, whether it supports OIDC, or how fast setup is. missing for 10: evidence of catalog size (thousands of apps), OIDC pre-built integrations, evidence that setup takes minutes, independent/hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects

citations.quote: প্রি-ইন্টিগ্রেটেড ক্যাটালগে নেই এমন একটি কাস্টম অ্যাপের সাথে SAML-ভিত্তিক SSO সেট আপ করতে এই ধাপগুলি অনুসরণ করুন।
L'authentification unique (SSO) permet aux utilisateurs de se connecter à toutes les applications cloud de leur entreprise à l'aide des identifiants de leur compte Google géré.
Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
